tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_single_exact_float
tests.intent: Probes that a single-precision ndarray with a value exactly representable as float round-trips as an ndarray.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_single_inexact_float
tests.intent: Probes that a single-precision ndarray containing 0.1 falls back to a plain object due to inexact representation.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_single_underflow
tests.intent: Probes that a single-precision ndarray with an element underflowing to zero falls back to a plain object.

tests.name: bjdata_ordered_json_key_order
tests.intent: Probes that ordered_json from_bjdata produces annotation keys in the order _ArrayType_, _ArraySize_, _ArrayData_.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_double_type
tests.intent: Probes round-trip of a double precision ND-array annotation.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_uint8_overflow
tests.intent: Probes that an integer ND-array with out-of-range value falls back to a plain object.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_multidimensional
tests.intent: Probes a multi-dimensional ND-array round trip with integer type.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_single_nan_inf
tests.intent: Probes that NaN and Infinity values in single precision ND-arrays are allowed and round-trip.

tests.name: bjdata_from_bjdata_basic
tests.intent: Probes basic from_bjdata error handling on empty data.

tests.name: bjdata_sax_parse_ndarray
tests.intent: Probes SAX parsing of BJData input containing an ND-array.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_char_type
tests.intent: Probes character array type mapping in BJData ND-arrays.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_int64_type
tests.intent: Probes 64-bit signed integer ND-array round-trip.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_uint64_type
tests.intent: Probes 64-bit unsigned integer ND-array round-trip.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_int8_type
tests.intent: Probes 8-bit signed integer ND-array round-trip.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_uint16_type
tests.intent: Probes 16-bit unsigned integer ND-array round-trip.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_int32_type
tests.intent: Probes 32-bit signed integer ND-array round-trip.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_uint32_type
tests.intent: Probes 32-bit unsigned integer ND-array round-trip.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_byte_type
tests.intent: Probes byte array type mapping in BJData ND-arrays.

tests.name: bjdata_ordered_json_doc_example
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json with the exact documented ND-array example structure.

tests.name: bjdata_ndarray_empty_data
tests.intent: Probes behavior of BJData ND-array serialization with empty data array.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise binary reader where an invalid ndarray type marker is encountered during size value parsing, triggering bjd_type_name == nullptr and parse_error with code 112.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise SAX consumer returning false during start_object(3) when opening an ndarray annotation.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise SAX consumer returning false during sax->key or sax->string when emitting the _ArrayType_ annotation.

tests.intent: Exercise write_bjdata_ndarray_float_element with NaN double values in the dry_run path.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise write_bjdata_ndarray_float_element with positive and negative Infinity values in the dry_run path.

tests.intent: Exercise write_bjdata_ndarray_float_element with NaN double values in the dry_run path.
